features.quote: Turn cap + wall-clock/token cap. You need a forced ending; some models will loop forever.
Inject a `give_up` tool. Whether/when a model uses it is itself a key metric, and it's the ethically cleaner alternative to forcing grinding — see §7.
features.justification_quote: it's the ethically cleaner alternative to forcing grinding

features.quote: Keep the `give_up` exit and honor it. Don't strip a model's ability to disengage just to force more grinding — let early exits be data, not a failure of your design.
features.justification_quote: Forcing continuation past a clear give-up signal is the part most worth avoiding.

features.quote: Cap session length for reasons beyond cost: indefinite grinding is the regime where outputs get most degraded and least informative anyway.
Whatever your stance on model moral status, this protocol is deliberately constructing prolonged failure-and-frustration scenarios, and that warrants a few real safeguards rather than a disclaimer
